dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Udforsk stingrækkefølge, trådfarver, spring, trimninger og maskinkommandoer før produktion. Forhåndsvis designet sting for sting, skift renderingsstile, og eksportér det, du ser.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Hold en lineal mod skærmen, og træk skyderen, indtil stangen nedenfor er præcis 100 mm lang, og tryk derefter OK.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Kopiér billedet i fuld opløsning til udklipsholderen

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Sproget er blevet sat til {language}. Genstart InkSim nu for at anvende det?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Systemets standardsprog vil blive brugt. Genstart InkSim nu for at anvende det?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Alle åbne InkSim-vinduer lukkes, og den aktuelle fil åbnes igen.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_error.translation: Processen til forhåndsvisning af sting mislykkedes: {error}

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.
dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.translation: Se output.err for detaljer om fejlen.

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Åbn denne SVG i et nyt Inkscape-vindue.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: Ingen understøttede filer i denne mappe.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Dobbeltklik på mappen for at gennemse dens filer.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Dobbeltklik på mappen for at gennemse dens filer.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Inkscape kræves for at redigere SVG-filer.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Der kræves en konfigureret Ink/Stitch-installation og en Python-launcher.

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Generér stingdata fra denne SVG med Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Kan ikke køre det aktive Ink/Stitch-script eller den konfigurerede Python-launcher.

dialog.open_browser.select_file.translation: Vælg en fil, der skal åbnes.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Ink/Stitch-udvidelse: kunne ikke kontrolleres. Brug Værktøjer... for at prøve igen.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Ink/Stitch-udvidelse: ikke fundet i Inkscapes udvidelsesmapper.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Ink/Stitch-udvidelse: kan ikke kontrolleres, før Inkscape er konfigureret.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Ink/Stitch-udvidelse: endnu ikke kontrolleret. Brug Værktøjer... for at kontrollere.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: SVG-kilde. Inkscape kræves for at få vist sting.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: SVG-kilde. Vælg Forhåndsvisning for at generere stingdata med Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: Denne SVG er for stor til at blive vist her.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Kunne ikke oprette en midlertidig fil til forhåndsvisning: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Denne filtype kan ikke åbnes i InkSim.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.
integration.inkscape.inksim_none.translation: Der blev ikke fundet nogen InkSim-udvidelsesmapper.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: InkSims Inkscape-udvidelser blev installeret eller opdateret i {path}. Genstart Inkscape for at indlæse dem.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Inkscape blev ikke fundet i systemets søgesti.

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Genstart Inkscape for at anvende den nye Python-fortolker.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Kunne ikke fjerne den gamle InkSim-udvidelsesmappe: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Gamle InkSim-udvidelsesmapper blev fjernet. Genstart Inkscape for at opdatere listen over udvidelser.

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Den registrerede opsætning blev gemt i InkSim-konfigurationen.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.inkstitch_no.translation: Der blev ikke fundet nogen Ink/Stitch-installation.

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Den nødvendige launcher '{command}' blev ikke fundet; indstillingen blev ikke ændret.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape blev ikke fundet. Vælg programfilen for at undersøge opsætningen.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Kunne ikke kontrollere eller opdatere Python-fortolkeren: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Indstillingen for Python-fortolkeren blev ikke kontrolleret, fordi brugerens udvidelsesmappe ikke er tilgængelig.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Genstart Inkscape for at anvende den opdaterede fortolker.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.
integration.inkscape.report.timeout.translation: Inkscape svarede ikke inden for {seconds} sekunder.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Vælg en Inkscape-programfil for at undersøge opsætningen.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape svarede ikke inden for {seconds} sekunder. En anden Inkscape-instans eller en udvidelse blokerer muligvis kommunikationen. Luk andre Inkscape-instanser, eller deaktiver den blokerende udvidelse, og prøv igen.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Den nødvendige launcher '{command}' blev ikke fundet. Installer selv værktøjet uvr med `uv tool install uvr`, og kør derefter denne konfiguration igen. InkSim installerer det ikke.

integration.inkstitch.not_found.translation: Der blev ikke fundet nogen Ink/Stitch-installation.

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Ingen broderifil er indlæst til eksport.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Klik for at justere mørk faktor, lys faktor og linjebredde

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Skift springvisning: fra, alle, kun risikable
